apps.name: LocalSend
apps.description: Share files and messages to nearby devices over the local network — no internet, no accounts.
apps.author: LocalSend
apps.notes:
This release also added the rpm package for the first time (e.g. for Fedora users).
Please note a breaking change in the CLI when sending files.

- feat: make sending checksums opt-in (@Tienisto)
- feat: format timestamps using system date and time settings (@ShlomoCode)
- feat: add keyboard shortcuts to accept or decline incoming transfers (@Tienisto)
- feat: restore hashtag codes for connecting to devices (@Tienisto)
- feat: show an HTTPS badge in the device list tile when encryption is enabled (@Tienisto)
- feat: show inbound/outbound reachability per device to help diagnose firewall issues (@Tienisto)
- feat: add a copy button to the log screens (@ShlomoCode)
- feat: add a Cancel button to the device name dialog (@ShlomoCode)
- feat: group the changelog by release and type, and show what's new after an update (@ShlomoCode)
- feat(cli): send text using --text, including input from stdin (@Tienisto)
- feat(cli)!: replace `--file` with the `send` command for sending files and directories (@otanim)
- feat(cli): add builds for Alpine Linux (@julianxhokaxhiu)
- feat(desktop): add an option to keep the LocalSend window above other windows (@ShlomoCode)
- feat(macos): use native window restoration to keep partially off-screen windows near their saved position (@ShlomoCode)
- feat(linux): support delta updates for the AppImage (@ShlomoCode)
- feat(linux): add x86_64 rpm package to release workflow (@basil)
- feat(linux): add software rendering toggle with automatic fallback after a rendering crash (@Tienisto)
- security: limit simultaneous incoming connections to prevent resource exhaustion (@Tienisto)
- security: prevent senders without a client certificate from impersonating favorite devices while sharing via link (@Tienisto)
- security(cli): sanitize remote text before displaying it in the terminal (@Tienisto)
- perf: reduce memory use during file transfers (@luojiyin1987)
- fix: strip request URLs from HTTP client errors so the PIN is not exposed (@Tienisto)
- fix: prevent a startup crash with legacy Quick Save settings (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: show the real error when a file cannot be read while sending, instead of transferring it as an empty file (@leopalmieri-spec)
- fix: bound inline text previews to prevent large-message freezes (@kneeyard126)
- fix: rank link-local IPv6 channels after IPv4 when choosing an address to dial (@Tienisto)
- fix: limit connection setup for pinned HTTP clients to 5 seconds (@Tienisto)
- fix: let cancellation interrupt reading prepare-upload and upload responses (@Tienisto)
- fix: stop a send session that was cancelled while prepare-upload was answering (@Tienisto)
- fix: avoid directory name collisions when receiving files (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: accept PINs containing special characters (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: release wakelock when a transfer fails (@bunnysayzz)
- fix: normalize filenames to NFC so Korean jamo display correctly on Windows (@GhagSagar23)
- fix: show the actual save location path for receiving files (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: allow scrolling in the edit favorites dialog (@samdelong)
- fix: validate the port when adding or editing a favorite device (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: show an error when web share translations fail to load (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: keep device name unchanged when cancelling the dialog (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: close favorite editor after confirming changes (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: pressing Enter now confirms file renaming (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: avoid adding a trailing dot when renaming files without an extension (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: hide unsupported troubleshooting options (@ShlomoCode)
- fix: apply zero-padding when numbering renamed files (@A-M-D-R-3-W)
- fix: avoid division by zero on the progress page when a file fails in the millisecond the session starts (@Tienisto)
- fix: keep the message input dialog usable with large text and an open keyboard (@ArtemChikolaev)
- fix: preserve the extension case and leading dot when numbering duplicate file names (@lingyicute)
- fix(cli): cancel pending web shortcuts when pressing non-character keys (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(desktop): respect custom error-403.html even when web sharing is disabled (@Tienisto)
- fix(mobile): prevent incomplete cache cleanup (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(android): allow receiving files with the same name after moving them to Trash (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(android): preserve file modification times when saving media to the gallery (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(android): keep file names when saving to a custom folder (@Tienisto)
- fix(android): can't open files with unrecognized extensions (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(android): avoid display flashes when opening or closing the app on some Android TVs (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(android): use the phone's configured name or model when selecting "Use system name" in settings (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(android): show an error when loading the installed apps list fails (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(ios): show LocalSend in the share menu on iOS 14 and 15 (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(ios): send shared links as text instead of two TXT files (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(macos): prevent intermittent MissingPluginException during startup (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(macos): file sharing via Share Extension doesn't work in DMG builds (@ShlomoCode, @vdmkotai)
- fix(macos): make Command+W close the window reliably (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(windows): fix LocalSend not opening after installation via WinGet (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(windows): correct the MSIX helper architecture in ARM64 builds (@Tienisto)
- fix(windows): sign the embedded uninstaller as well as the installer (@Tienisto)
- fix(windows): close the running app and remove autostart, the Send to shortcut and firewall rules on uninstall (@Tienisto)
- fix(windows): show the LocalSend icon in the Share Sheet and "Share with" menu (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(linux): prevent .deb startup failure when legacy AppIndicator is installed (@Tienisto)
- fix(linux): load bundled Rust library relative to the executable (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(linux): add EGL and GLES dependencies to deb package (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(linux): require glibc 2.34 when installing the DEB package (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(linux): Flatpak drag-and-drop for files outside Downloads (@loucass)
- fix(linux): keep keyboard shortcuts working when Num Lock is enabled (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(linux): respect `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, safely remove the desktop entry, and set its icon (@vicajilau)
- fix(linux): install rpm icon without setuid, set StartupWMClass and require libappindicator-gtk3 (@Tienisto)
- fix(linux): name rpm desktop file after the application id so KWin shows the app icon (@Tienisto)
- fix(linux): wrong window icon in deb installations on KDE Wayland (@Tienisto)
- fix(linux): tray icon fails to load in Snap installations (@vicajilau)
- fix(linux): show the AppImage icon in the GNOME dash (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(linux): restore the dock icon for deb installations (@vicajilau)
- fix(linux): show "LocalSend" as title in the system tray (@Josephur)
- fix(linux): match the native title bar to the app theme (@ShlomoCode)
- fix(linux): don't show the farewell message during deb upgrades or reinstalls (@ShlomoCode)
- i18n: add Kyrgyz (@nidara-duo)

apps.name: draw.io
apps.description: Diagramming app — flowcharts, UML, network and architecture diagrams, fully offline.
apps.author: JGraph
apps.notes:
## Release Notes for 32.7.4

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/draw.io-32.7.4-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/draw.io-32.7.4-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/draw.io-universal-32.7.4.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/drawio-amd64-32.7.4.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/drawio-x86_64-32.7.4.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.7.4/drawio-x86_64-32.7.4.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.11.3
- Fixes HTML export from the command line failing or hanging on very large diagrams
- Stops reading a diagram embedded in a PNG or PDF file once it is longer than the longest text the app can hold, instead of decompressing all of it first
- Command line PDF exports with --width or --height now contain the diagram, fitted to that size, instead of an empty page [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2162]
- Command line PDF and SVG exports fill in %pagecount% [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2601]
- Command line exports no longer wait forever for an image whose server never answers: an image that makes no progress for 15 seconds is left out and the export completes
- Links in exported SVG and PDF files keep only safe link types, and PDF exports no longer contain links to the install folder
- The Grid option of the advanced export dialog now works in the desktop app
- Removes data sources from the desktop app, where they could never load
- The public repository now carries the Linux source of each release; the Windows and macOS packaging files are no longer published there
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.7.4](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.7.4/ChangeLog). All changes from 32.6.10 to 32.7.4 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste, save without a dialog, reopen, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and to PNG and PDF from the app
- Diagram round trip in an exported PNG and PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid and CSV import, and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, stencils and shape bundles, the export dialogs and the print dialog
- Settings survive a restart
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed, separately signed and registered
- The Electron security fuses are applied
- Reads, writes and file checks of paths the user has not authorised are refused, and file and javascript links are not opened externally
- The update manifests of all five platforms name this version and files that exist
- 348 unit tests pass

Command line exports

- %pagecount% resolves in PDF exports of all pages, of a single page and in SVG exports, and page variables work for files without pages [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2601]
- A 3000 by 97 shape exported with --width 500 gives a page 500 units wide that the diagram fills edge to edge, --height gives the requested height, and --width with all pages gives each page that width [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2162]
- With an image server that accepts the connection and never answers, PNG, PDF and SVG with embedded images complete in 16 to 18 seconds with the rest of the diagram
- HTML export of a PNG or PDF with an embedded diagram recovers all three pages, and a PNG without a diagram is reported and skipped in a folder export

Links in exports

- An SVG export keeps https and relative links and drops ms-msdt, vbscript, search-ms and data links; a PDF export keeps only the https link and no link to the install folder
- Links of a page used as a background are not active in PDF exports

Checks around the changes

- The Grid option changes PNG and PDF exports from the advanced export dialog
- Copy as Image places a PNG image on the system clipboard
- Data sources are absent from the menus and from Page Setup
- Starting with DRAWIO_ENV=dev loads the packaged editor without errors

apps.name: Logseq
apps.description: Local-first outliner and knowledge base over plain markdown with backlinks and graph view.
apps.author: Logseq
apps.notes:
Logseq 2.0.2 Beta brings smoother editing, faster startup, and more reliable everyday workflows to the DB version.

[Join the iOS TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/eBcJ9Hpc), 2.0.2 is currently under App Store review.

Web app: https://app.logseq.com/

## Features

- Gallery cards can now use URL properties as covers.
- Added a "Clear heading" slash command.
- Improved video embeds, with resizable desktop players and clickable YouTube timestamps.

## Thanks

- **Special thanks to our community PR contributors!** Your fixes, performance improvements, translations, and careful reviews helped make this beta better. Contributors include [@yuxi-liu-wired](https://github.com/yuxi-liu-wired), [@ChipNowacek](https://github.com/ChipNowacek), [@Mancn-Xu](https://github.com/Mancn-Xu), [@hahaArthur17](https://github.com/hahaArthur17), [@maksym-dilanian](https://github.com/maksym-dilanian), [@qwist1233-cpu](https://github.com/qwist1233-cpu), and many others.
- **A heartfelt thank-you to everyone testing the DB beta.** Your bug reports, reproduction steps, feedback, and retesting of fixes have been invaluable. Thank you for helping us improve Logseq with your real-world graphs and workflows!

## Fixed issues

Ordered by impact on data integrity, reliability, and everyday workflows.

1. **Preserve unsaved edits:** Save pending text before following page or block references, switching blocks, or setting Deadline/Scheduled. Pasting multiple blocks no longer lets a stale editor buffer erase the first pasted title.
2. **Restore deleted content with undo/redo:** Restore deleted blocks and pages that reference each other, along with property schemas and values. Undoing block moves now preserves their original order and nested structure.
3. **Keep block trees intact when copying or moving:** Selecting an ancestor together with its descendants no longer pulls grandchildren out of their subtree. Copy/paste preserves the original child blocks, and embed actions operate on the embed rather than its source.
4. **Keep graph and asset downloads running:** One failed asset download no longer stops the remaining asset queue or fails the graph download. Sync also keeps property-value replacements together instead of splitting them across requests.
5. **Fix Windows installation:** Fix the NSIS installer crash affecting Windows 11 24H2 and newer, so the desktop app can be installed normally.
6. **Improve file-to-DB import fidelity:** Preserve headings, icons, journal timestamps, and PDF annotation identities/order. Asset links in property values are converted into asset references, and same-title classes and properties remain distinct.
7. **Correct scheduled dates and repeating tasks:** Deadline/Scheduled repeats now advance in the local calendar. Monthly repeats no longer drift permanently after a shorter month; date filters use local days, and clearing dates removes stale journal references.
8. **Prevent query errors from crashing the graph:** Incomplete query syntax, invalid regular expressions, and query-function rendering errors are isolated. Query-builder filters again show property/tag names and include custom Status and Priority choices.
9. **Fix property editing and choice selection:** Selected node values remain visible in property pickers, choice identities resolve consistently, and configuration toggles save the newly selected value. Empty multi-value slots and date values can be cleared without errors.
10. **Restore readable search results and references:** Resolve UUID references in search titles, breadcrumbs, and nested page references. References to deleted nodes remain visible as broken links, and opening search no longer clears its results.
11. **Restore settings and HTML publishing:** Settings can be saved when config.edn is missing or invalid, and the first export.css edit creates the file correctly. HTML exports no longer open as a blank page and honor the configured home page.
12. **Make desktop editing and keyboard input reliable:** Clicks during scrolling now open the editor. A click after Escape or Shift+Up/Down keeps the newly opened editor, and fixes cover international dead-key input and IME confirmation in search.
13. **Fix Android popup and layout issues:** Nested popups reuse the presented native sheet, sheet dismissal avoids re-entry, and the layout respects the status-bar safe area. Mobile cloud-graph download and sync triggers work again.

## Enhancements

- **Faster startup and smoother editing:** Improved desktop startup, journal loading, large-page rendering, table scrolling, and search, with fewer unnecessary updates while typing.
- **Better everyday workflows:** Improved flashcard practice, date and repeating-task handling, international keyboard input, plugin APIs, CLI behavior, and translations.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/logseq/logseq/compare/2.0.1...2.0.2)
